name: @qandeel-company/secret-vault
description: L1-01 Windows user-scoped secret vault: opaque `vault:<name>` references resolved to secret values only inside a governed executor's private callback. The Windows vault protects each secret with built-in DPAPI (CurrentUser scope) through the signed Windows PowerShell host — no third-party password manager, no native addon, no plaintext file, nothing in Git, SQLite, the Company workspace, backups, artifacts, logs, prompts or command-line arguments. An in-memory vault serves CI. The `qandeel-vault set <name>` command prompts without echo and never accepts the secret as an argument.
